sonnet.problem: Verse 10 doesn't say who is speaking, but the card names the speaker as "the prophet." The passage and its heading never name him. Card 4's question repeats this with "The prophet says."
sonnet.rule: When the text doesn't say who is speaking, he doesn't guess. He uses a plain lead-in, like "Then the psalm says…", and names a speaker only when the passage or its heading does.

sonnet.problem: This story card repeats "peace, peace," which card 11 just asked and revealed as its answer. It adds almost nothing new beyond the question about shame, so it works as a recap of verse 14.
